description: This plugin extracts CSS into separate files. It creates a CSS file per JS file which contains CSS.

exports.name: CssExtractRspackPlugin
exports.summary:
CssExtractRspackPlugin is the CSS extract plugin for Lynx.
It works just like the [CssExtractRspackPlugin](https://rspack.rs/plugins/rspack/css-extract-rspack-plugin.html) in Web.

members.name: defaultOptions
members.summary: `defaultOptions` is the default options that the [`CssExtractRspackPlugin`](api:CssExtractRspackPlugin) uses.

members.name: loader
members.remarks: It should be used with the ['css-loader'](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader).

members.name: apply
members.summary: The entry point of a webpack plugin.

members.name: chunkFilename
members.summary: The name of non-initial CSS chunk files
members.remarks:
When set, CSS chunks of lazy bundles still go to
`.lynx/lazy-bundle/<name>/<layer>.css` (or `.lynx/lazy-bundle/<name>.css`
when the chunk has no layer); this template applies to the other chunks.

members.name: filename
members.summary: The name of each output bundle.

exports.name: LoaderOptions
exports.summary: The options of CSS extract loader.

members.name: emit
members.summary:
The same as [mini-css-extract-plugin](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin/tree/master?tab=readme-ov-file#emit).
Control whether emit the CSS to filesystem.

- If `true`(default), emits a file (writes a file to the filesystem).

- If `false`, the plugin will extract the CSS but will not emit the file.

It is often useful to disable this option for server-side packages.

members.name: layer
members.summary: The layer of the CSS execution.
